label: StudyE9d-delay: delivered value as a function of ADDED DELAY, and the loss from a blocking window, on StudyD14b's 0.25-s grid with StudyE9b's delivery model. OFFLINE REPLAY OF COMMITTED RESULTS; CPU only on flash; no GPU, no model server, no inference. Scores are continuous log P(Yes); no literal Yes/No answer is used anywhere. THIS JOB PRODUCES CURVES AND MAKES NO POLICY CLAIM. Challenge mAP and streaming AP are reported under their own names and are never mixed (StudyE9c).

a_zero_delay_reproduces_e9b_and_e9c.description: At d = 0 this engine must reproduce StudyE9b's streaming AP (point AND CI) and StudyE9c's challenge AP / mAP for the same arms, setting and cadence. A failure is a STOP condition. The streaming cells use StudyE9b's own AP code and must agree BIT FOR BIT; the challenge cells are recomputed here with scikit-learn, the function StudyE9c used, so they must agree bit for bit too (control (d) separately licenses the vectorised AP used inside the bootstrap).

b_empty_window_reproduces_zero_delay.description: An EMPTY window (j1 < j0, zero steps long) must leave the delivered stream identical to StudyE9b's held_stream at the same cadence and shift.

c_full_clip_suspend_equals_device.description: SUSPEND with a window covering every grid index must deliver exactly the device's own stream, so both metrics must equal the device arm's.

d_vectorised_ap_equals_sklearn.description: The AP used inside the bootstrap must equal sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score on every real cell, including its tie handling.
d_vectorised_ap_equals_sklearn.note: the two differ only in floating-point summation order; the worst difference is reported so the reader can see its size rather than take 'equal' on trust

blocking_placement_rule: window start index uniform on [0, G - W] so the window lies ENTIRELY inside the clip and every window has exactly length w; 20 placements per clip from one rng(seed 0) draw shared across arms, modes and window lengths (so the comparison is paired); 0 clips were too short for any w (min G = 61 steps, max W = 16)
